English:
Do you think us defeating Dhaos
here will prevent my parents' deaths?

I...don't think we can reverse
what has already happened.

It's not your fault. Think we'll be able to
save <Chester> and Mr. Morrison, at least?
I imagine--No, I'm absolutely *sure* we can.

I'm glad you feel the same way. I think
that's why Mr. Morrison chose to send us here.
